answer_1.quote: We aim to understand the collaboration capabilities of LLMs through a case study of collaborative poetry writing... We collect 873,574 <instruction, poem_line> pairs from publicly available poem corpora and Reddit ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate how well the models satisfy the constraints specified in the instructions on each of the test sets... We report the success rate of satisfying the instructions... We also compute the proportion of the submitted poems that was taken from the model generations using the Rouge-L recall metric.

answer_4.quote: We conduct pairwise comparison: each annotator is shown an instruction and generations from both models... Rate the fluency of each verse on a scale of 1-5. Does each verse adequately satisfy the instruction? (Yes/No) Which of the two verses is more creative... We recruit crowd workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate relevance and preference of poems.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate fluency (1‑5), indicate whether the instruction is satisfied (yes/no), compare creativity, and choose the preferred poem based on relevance, coherence, and style.
